title: Just discovered AI Agentic a Pine Script optimizer that surprised me
author: iamnikiii
selftext:
I've always optimized my strategies manually in TradingView. Change a parameter, run a backtest, repeat... over and over.

Recently I found a website that automatically optimizes your Pine Script strategy by searching for better parameter combinations.

I uploaded my Bitcoin strategy and let it run through the optimization process.

The result was better than I expected:

* Return improved from **3.5% to 8.95%**
* It also found parameter combinations I honestly wouldn't have tested myself.

Obviously, optimization isn't everything, and overfitting is always a concern, so I'm planning to validate everything on out-of-sample data before using it live.
